energy.description: Sunlight strength in watts per meter squared (W/m²)

shadow_buffer_clip_start.description: Shadow map clip start, below which objects will not generate shadows

shadow_soft_size.description: Light size for ray shadow sampling (Raytraced shadows)

shadow_filter_radius.description: Blur shadow aliasing using Percentage Closer Filtering

shadow_maximum_resolution.description: Minimum size of a shadow map pixel. Higher values use less memory at the cost of shadow quality.

use_shadow_jitter.description: Enable jittered soft shadows to increase shadow precision (disabled in viewport unless enabled in the render settings). Has a high performance impact.

shadow_jitter_overblur.description: Apply shadow tracing to each jittered sample to reduce under-sampling artifacts

shadow_cascade_max_distance.description: End distance of the cascaded shadow map (only in perspective view)

shadow_cascade_count.description: Number of texture used by the cascaded shadow map

shadow_cascade_exponent.description: Higher value increase resolution towards the viewpoint

shadow_cascade_fade.description: How smooth is the transition between each cascade

energy.description: Light energy emitted over the entire area of the light in all directions, in units of radiant power (W)
